en: Your queue as a stack of CDs next to the player: tap it to see, reorder or remove songs
Song titles on a retro LCD screen; long titles scroll
Pick your own look in Settings: a base colour and a key colour
Playback is more reliable: it recovers from network drops and keeps playing on iPhone in the background
A small Wi-Fi sign shows when your connection is slow
NEW stays on an album until you open it
"What's new" and the app version in the profile menu
Fresh pixel look: new tab icons, CD frames, clearer numbers and tidier pages
